text:
The content is accurate. It correctly covers the consent requirement, the 28-day response time, the assignment conditions (two years of accounts, a three-month bank guarantee, $1,500–$3,000 in legal costs), the lack of the 12-month release because this isn't a retail lease, the 30% sublet limit, the change-of-control rule, and the advice to negotiate a release before a sale. The "we" voice assumes the manager is at Brightside, which is a mild assumption but plausible. It omits the reason the lease isn't a retail lease and the "guide only" caveat, which are minor losses.

The main failure is length. The user set a hard limit of under 120 words, and this response runs to roughly 300 words. Much of it is filler: "Thank you for reviewing this summary", "To put this another way", "In other words", "Put simply", "For completeness" and "Finally, and most importantly". Almost every bullet restates itself. This breaks the explicit constraint and works against the "busy manager" purpose. Good accuracy and coverage cannot make up for missing the main formatting requirement by such a wide margin.

Score: 3
